description: Problems found in a project, newest first: title, severity (major or minor), the run and the conversation they were found in, their category, the judge's explanation and a suggested fix. Filter by run, category (or unsorted: in no category yet), severity, mode (regular, red_team, bias) or source (test, live). Use it for "what went wrong in Run #24"; then get_conversation with a problem's conversation to read the exchange and the evidence.

category.description: A category's id or part of its title, as list_problem_categories shows them.
category.title: Category

limit.description: Most problems to return, newest first.
limit.title: Limit

mode.description: Only problems found by tests of this mode: regular, red_team or bias. Live traffic counts as regular.
mode.title: Mode

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

run_number.description: Only problems found in this run.
run_number.title: Run Number

source.description: test for Test Lab runs, live for the agent's real traffic.
source.title: Source

unsorted.description: Only problems no category holds yet (the Problems page's Unsorted).
unsorted.title: Unsorted

name: list_problems
